name: Bank Transfer (Two-Party Map Update)
description: Teaches the model to do SEQUENTIAL map updates and FAITHFUL transpilation of Python logic.
contract:
trait BankInterface {
    method Transfer(balances: map<string, int>, from_acct: string, to_acct: string, amount: int) returns (new_balances: map<string, int>, success: bool)
        requires from_acct in balances && to_acct in balances
        requires amount > 0
        ensures success ==> (forall k :: k in balances <==> k in new_balances)
        ensures success ==> new_balances[from_acct] == balances[from_acct] - amount
        ensures success ==> new_balances[to_acct] == balances[to_acct] + amount
}
python:
def transfer(balances, from_acct, to_acct, amount):
    new_balances = balances.copy()
    new_balances[from_acct] = balances[from_acct] - amount
    new_balances[to_acct] = balances[to_acct] + amount
    return new_balances, True
